def _apply_padding(self, x_data):
    """
    Zero-pad the spatial dimensions of the input numpy array.
    """
    if self.padding > 0:
        return np.pad(x_data,
                     ((0, 0), (0, 0),
                      (self.padding, self.padding),
                      (self.padding, self.padding)),
                     mode='constant', constant_values=0)
    else:
        return x_data
